spiritgiven.comments: We felt that the attitude on calls was confrontational, with players unwilling to listen to discussion. Some of our calls on disc space were not respected and body contact was egregious. The discussion of the rules was used to benefit Colombia in almost every situation with little consideration for fairness and spirit of the game.

It was an intense game with a lot of physical contact. We appreciate the efficient discussion on-field and the frequent check-ins on spirit and contact. While we sensed the improvement in body contact in the second half, we feel there is still more room for improvement but appreciated the game nonetheless.
This was a fun and very fair game even with the wind. All calls were made with a calm tone and discussions were efficient on the field. Thank you for a good game!
This was a very exciting and fair minded game. Thank you and good luck!
We had a fun game and felt it was very fair. Communication was great throughout and we appreciated the efficient discussion and resolution of calls.
This was a really joyful and intense game. Even with a tight score and fouls on the field, we felt that all calls were resolved quickly and fairly. Muchas gracias, Argentina!
This was a really fun game. We felt the spirit all game was very high and all calls were resolved well. Thanks for a great game, GB!
This game is really fair and have fun so much.

spiritreceived.comments: Very open to listening and communicating both ways

Thanks so much for the game! We thought that it was a spirited game and calls were discussed quickly and fairly.

Thank you for being fair minded and understanding about our accidental physicality. Best of luck to you!
Some of the calls took advantage of the situation. They doubled teamed the entire game and didn’t correct after many feedbacks on the captains.
Really great game! There were a few discussions held during the game but all were resolved pretty fairly and quickly

Thank you for the very enjoyable game. All discussions felt friendly and respectful. We’d also like to mention that there were a couple of layout or run-through bids made that were very safe and careful of other player’s space. Thank you and welcome to Australia.
